name: Non Deliverable Forward Valuation Conditions 2
definition: Set of parameters used to calculate the fixing rate to be applied to a non-deliverable agreement.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Specifies the currency in which the non deliverable trade has to be settled ie the deliverable currency.

ValuationDate.name: Valuation Date
ValuationDate.definition: Date at which the rate used for calculating the net amount to be settled is observed.

AdditionalValuationInformation.name: Additional Valuation Information
AdditionalValuationInformation.definition: Free format text that may contain valuation information such as the place, the time or the source of the rate.

SettlementParty.name: Settlement Party
SettlementParty.definition: Party through which the settlement will take place. It may contain the BIC of a central settlement system eg CLSBUS33.
